SUTF framing

SUCS UTF-8, UTF-16 and UTF-32.

Encoding Unit Covers Notes
SUTF-8 1–4 bytes Full 31-bit space Default stream encoding; standard UTF-8 leading-byte framing
SUTF-16 2 or 4 bytes Full 31-bit space Word framing with a marker bit (1 word to 0x7FFF, 2 words above); no surrogates — 0xD800–0xDFFF are valid PUA. Byte order explicit: BE canonical (sust16) or LE
SUTF-32 4 bytes (LE) Full 31-bit space Lossless fixed-width form for native allocations

Reference implementations live in modules/sutf (framing) and modules/sust (byte serialization, BE canonical/LE); the framing tables are published at Public/0.1.0/sutf/. Extended codepoints use vector, vsutf and e-SUST.
